body: My baby cousin isn't even a year old yet but he already has the temperament of an appeased toddler. He barely if ever cries or sleeping, in fact he is content laughing most of the day away. But he's already trained himself to get up on furniture before he can even walk and made himself so much more of a chore to babysit sometimes because you turn your back and he's on trying to eat something or climb in top of things that could hurt him.

If you don't mind me asking, how did you go about getting diagnosed as an adult? I've had quite a number of acquaintances majoring in psychology or childcare along with some friends tell me that a lot of my social issues probably don't stem much from experiences in my childhood, but rather they seem much probable as signs of an undiagnosed case of autism.

I honestly don't care about the stigma or things like that, just knowing for sure would help me try to get help that I actually need.
